title: Find Median from Data Stream
description: Maintain a median of a stream of numbers using two heaps (max-heap for lower half, min-heap for upper half).
pseudocode:
1. Add num to lower heap
2. Move largest of lower to upper heap
3. Balance sizes: if upper > lower, move back
4. If lower.size > upper.size return lower.peek()
5. Else return (lower.peek() + upper.peek()) / 2

steps.note: Move 5 to upper heap (min-heap) to maintain order
Balance heaps: upper heap is size 1, lower 0. Move 5 back.
Move 10 (max of lower) to upper heap
Lower size (1) == Upper size (1), median is average
